card.name: The word time after "at any"
card.fires_on: The word "time" in the phrase "can occur at any time", in NSAID warnings about stomach and intestinal bleeding, ulceration and perforation.

modes.label: At any time
modes.description: The word "time" completes "at any time" right after a warning that serious GI events can be fatal.
modes.example: These serious adverse events can occur at any<< time>>, with or without warning symptoms, in

card.writes: It pushes against unit-of-time words such as months, weeks, days and years, which fits a phrase that is already complete.
card.plain: It marks the word "time" in "can occur at any time" in the stomach and bowel bleeding warning.
